name: Moody Shadows by Gilmar Smith
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
Moody Shadows is crafted to infuse your images with a rich, dark ambiance reminiscent of classic paintings. This preset protects and enhances the shadows, introducing a matte effect that adds depth and texture. By lowering the highlights and white point while raising the black-point, it creates a soft, buttery, painterly quality. Adding gentle, warm tones to shadows, mid-tones, and highlights provides a cohesive and inviting feel. With Moody Shadows, your photos will have a sophisticated, atmospheric look, combining contrast and subtle warmth to create a beautifully balanced and moody aesthetic.
Note: When applying Moody Shadows in NX Studio rather than in-camera, we recommend adding +0.50 EV exposure compensation. The preset settings will naturally darken the image, so this adjustment will ensure a well-balanced final result.
